died.name: Thomas Woolston
died.last_words: This is a struggle which all men must go through, and which I bear not only with patience, but with willingness.

died.name: William Gadsby
died.cause: raising his hand before the word "forever"
died.last_words: I shall soon be with Him. Victory, victory, victory forever.

died.name: John James Audubon
died.cause: speaking to his friend William Bakewell while suffering from senility
died.last_words: Yes, yes, Billy! You go down that side on Long Pond, and I'll go this side, and we'll get the ducks.

died.name: Edward Alderson
died.last_words: The worse, the better for me.

died.name: Isaac Babel
died.cause: prior to execution by firing squad on fabricated charges of terrorism and espionage
died.last_words: I am only asking for one thing-let me finish my work.

died.name: Gus Grissom
died.cause: during Apollo 1 launch rehearsal test moments before a deadly fire broke out
died.last_words: How are we going to get to the moon if we can't talk between two or three buildings?

died.name: Roger B. Chaffee
died.cause: reporting that a fire had broken out during Apollo 1 launch rehearsal test
died.last_words: We've got a bad fire! Let's get out... We're burning up!

born.name: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart
born.last_words: The taste of death is upon my lips... I feel something, that is not of this earth.

born.name: Gomes Freire de Andrade
born.cause: sentenced to death after being accused of leading a conspiracy against the country's British military government in the name of King John VI
born.last_words: I have always loved the Fatherland and I was never a traitor. Forgive me, all; and you soldiers, who have always been my people, keep serving the Fatherland as always the Portuguese have.

born.name: Lewis Carroll
born.last_words: Take away these pillows, I won't need them any longer.

born.name: Dmitri Mendeleev
born.last_words: Doctor, you have science, I have faith.

born.name: Wilhelm II
born.cause: dying of a pulmonary embolism at Huis Doorn
born.last_words: It's coming to an end for me, I'm sinking, I'm sinking!

born.name: Stjepan Filipović
born.last_words: "Death to fascism! Freedom to the people!" (Smrt fašizmu, sloboda narodu!)
